description.narrative: This indicator measures the level of engagement and commitment of MPs towards addressing the needs and concerns of disadvantaged or underrepresented groups. It reflects the extent to which MPs are actively involved in drafting legislation, policy papers, and parliamentary inquiries that focus on issues affecting these groups. By tracking the number of such initiatives, this indicator provides insights into the legislative efforts made to promote equality, inclusivity, and social justice for these marginalized communities.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of tools that have been specifically developed within political parties to promote and support womens participation in politics, with the assistance and funding from the European Union. These tools can include training programs, mentorship initiatives, networking platforms, and other resources aimed at empowering women within political party structures. The development of such tools is crucial for creating a more inclusive and genderbalanced political landscape, as they provide women with the necessary support and opportunities to actively engage in decisionmaking processes.

title.narrative: Number of parliamentary organizations that have developed an action agenda to promote the participation of women in politics with the EU support

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of parliamentary organizations that have received support from the European Union (EU) to develop an action agenda aimed at promoting womens participation in politics. It specifically focuses on initiatives and strategies implemented by these organizations to increase the representation and involvement of women in political decisionmaking processes. The indicator provides insights into the level of commitment and progress made by parliamentary organizations in addressing gender inequality and promoting genderresponsive governance within their respective countries or regions.

title.narrative: Number of women regularly using existing womens platforms to express their political rights and gain political visibility with the support of the EU.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of women who actively utilize established womens platforms to exercise their political rights and enhance their political visibility, with the assistance and backing of the European Union. These platforms serve as spaces for women to voice their opinions, advocate for gender equality, and participate in decisionmaking processes at various levels of governance. The indicator aims to quantify the extent to which these platforms effectively empower women to engage with politics and foster their active participation in shaping policies that affect them.

title.narrative: Womens Political Empowerment Index (WPEI).

description.narrative: To enhance the equal participation and leadership of women in political life in Ethiopia

title.narrative: Proportion of seats held by women in (a) national parliaments and (b) local governments

description.narrative: SDG indicator 5.5.1 under (a) measures the proportion of seats held by women in (a) national parliaments, currently as at 1 January of reporting year, is currently measured as the number of seats held by women members in single or lower chambers of national parliaments, expressed as a percentage of all occupied seats. National parliaments can be bicameral or unicameral. This indicator covers the single chamber in unicameral parliaments and the lower chamber in bicameral parliaments. It does not cover the upper chamber of bicameral parliaments. Seats are usually won by members in general parliamentary elections. Seats may also be filled by nomination, appointment, indirect election, rotation of members and byelection. Seats refer to the number of parliamentary mandates, or the number of members of parliament.Data reported against SDG indicators can be retrieved from the official UN SDG Database and Statistics https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/unsdg. Users are not expected to encode values for these indicators.For more detailed information, see https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata/

title.narrative: Gender equality rating, according to the World Banks Country Political and Institutional Assessment (CPIA)

description.narrative: The World Banks Country Political and Institutional Assessment includes an annual gender equality rating. The rating is from 1 (low) to 6 (high). This assessment examines the extent to which the country has installed institutions and programs to enforce laws and policies that promote equal access for men and women in education, health, the economy, and protection under law. The assessment focuses on elements which are under the countrys control, rather than higher level results (such as economic growth rates) that are influenced by events beyond the countrys control.
